results.note: six labels, locations, count, freshness, duration, expansion and inert content

packagedRuntime.harness: scripts/lsp-packaged-smoke.cjs executed by the packaged Electron binary (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1)

resultSizes.note: Tokens are a characters/4 estimate, not a tokenizer measurement.

stress.note: Requests are serialized per workspace, so concurrent callers queue; measured latency includes queue wait.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: After 128 distinct files the open-document budget had no eviction, so every new file query failed with DOCUMENT_LIMIT for the rest of the session.
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: probe: refresh failed at file 128 code=DOCUMENT_LIMIT, documents.size=128
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Bounded least-recently-queried eviction with a didClose to the server.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: closeRoot/close awaited the pending initialize request, so quitting while a server was initializing blocked for the full 20 s initialization timeout.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Terminate the client first when the entry never reached ready, aborting the pending initialize request.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: After an unexpected server exit the workspace was poisoned permanently: every later acquire failed with SERVER_UNAVAILABLE and no restart existed.
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: probe: reacquire FAILED code = SERVER_UNAVAILABLE, spawned servers = 1
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Bounded automatic restart (max 3 per root) that replaces the entry so documents are re-opened with didOpen instead of didChange.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: lsp_diagnostics read the publication map immediately after opening the document, so it almost always answered pending with zero findings even for a file with a known type error.
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: packaged smoke before the fix: diagnosticState=pending, diagnosticCount=0; after the fix: diagnosticState=stale, diagnosticCount=22
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Bounded, event-driven wait on the manager's per-document publication event (no polling loop, no fixed sleep).

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: check() closed the whole shared workspace server for any identity error, including transient filesystem or database failures, interrupting other authorized callers.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Only a definite WORKSPACE_UNAUTHORIZED retires the shared server.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: The 25 ms authorization re-check during a request could pile up overlapping realpath and database lookups.
The failed-server filter looked up the registry by the configured project root while the registry is keyed by the canonical realpath, so a failed server stayed advertised for aliased roots.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Bounded alias index in the manager resolves the canonical root.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: A child session removed from the live registry kept its LSP authorization in the weak map.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: forgetChild demotes and drops the authorization.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: A recovered child could never use LSP again, even though a fresh spawn would have been authorized.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Recovery re-authorizes the child at the default child ceiling (Workspace Write), never Full Access, and only while the owning parent is currently eligible.
